name: Driversnote
summary: Driversnote logs trips automatically, lets managers collect and approve driver reports, and exports them to PDF or Excel. The Teams plan costs $11 per license a month, and the Free plan covers 15 trips a month.

facts.text: Trips are captured automatically as the team drives, and manually added trips are flagged and shown on a map.
Companies set their own mileage rates. The page says custom rates are an option, and it does not say IRS rates are applied automatically.
Drivers submit reports, and managers can approve, reject or check a route on a map from one dashboard.
Reports can be exported to PDF or Excel, for one driver or for the whole team.
The Free plan covers 15 trips a month, and the iBeacon is listed at $40 and is not included in Free.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Automatic trip logging on iOS, Android and web. Reports for up to 15 trips a month.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Unlimited trips and reporting, an edit log and public API access. Includes a free iBeacon with a yearly subscription.

plans.name: Teams
plans.unit: per license per month, teams of 2 to 10
plans.notes: Adds web tools for admins to collect and validate reports. Includes a free iBeacon with a yearly subscription.

plans.name: Teams +
plans.notes: Adds single sign-on, a tailored onboarding session and a Customer Success Manager.

hiddenCosts: The page does not list a separate annual price for any plan.
The US pricing page lists prices in dollars and says they exclude taxes. The page does not name a currency code.
The iBeacon costs $40 on the Free plan, and it is included with a yearly subscription on Pro and Teams.
